WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM player_college
    GROUP BY college_id
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count,
           SUM(record_count) AS total_count
    FROM college_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT cc.record_count,
           o.avg_count,
           o.total_count
    FROM college_counts AS cc
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE cc.record_count > o.avg_count
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(record_count * 1.0 / total_count) AS average_share_of_total,
       AVG(record_count - avg_count) AS average_excess_overall_average
FROM above_average;
